about_the_game:
All around the world, people are vanishing without a trace. No one knows why some say invisible rifts in space-time are pulling them into places outside our reality.

Somnium Corp has emerged with a solution. Using their invention, the TecPod, agents can be teleported into these fractured dimensions known as Branches. Inside, time stands still and the familiar becomes deeply unsettling.

To support their agents, Somnium Corp provides each with a Whiteframe a personal pocket dimension housing a corporate facility. From here you prepare for missions, customize your hub, and store the resources you bring back.

Once inside a Branch, you must:

  • Complete the Main Mission – The only way to close the tear and escape alive.

  • Take on Contracts – Optional objectives chosen before deployment for extra Credits.

  • Explore & Scavenge – Search vast, handcrafted environments like empty malls, museums, and suburbs frozen in time.

  • Survive the Unreality – Face the eerie silence of liminal spaces and the horrors that linger there, alone or with your team.

Fail, and Somnium Corp will intervene — but their help comes at a cost, deducted from your pay.

The cause of the vanishings remains unknown. The rifts grow wider. And every mission brings you closer to the truth of the Unreality.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 2600 or Intel Core i5-9600K
  • Memory: 16000 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2060 or AMD RX 6700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 5600X or Intel Core i5-12400
  • Memory: 16000 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3060 or AMD RX 6700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

short_description: Close the rifts, survive the horrors beyond reality, and escape before the branch collapses. Unreality: Beyond Worlds is a multiplayer co-op survival horror where every contract is a fight against the unknown.
